notes.description: A silent bolt that downs an unarmoured player in one hit, if you lead and lift for its flight.
notes.design: A bolt you can watch fly: 100 on a hit (an unarmoured player down in one), but it flies at 75 m/s and drops, so past 20 m you lead and lift. No flash, no tracer line: the bolt itself is all anyone sees. One bolt, then a 1 s reload. The Medieval set's precision weapon.
notes.model: The owner's Medieval Repeating Arbalest (Meshy, owned; content/guns.json, 2026-11-28): 0.95 m, its bow 0.68 m across, held copies a 50,000-triangle cut, the owner's plain Scope low on its top rail (content/optics.json rifle_scope since 2026-11-28: the Brass Sentinel stood out too far on its tall mount; aimed through the full-screen scope as before); its bolt in flight is drawn in code (the `arrow` look). The kit marksman rifle is the fallback.
